# HyperPhysics

> > A comprehensive physics reference covering electromagnetism, optics, nuclear physics, relativity, and thermodynamics with interactive concept maps.

HyperPhysics is an educational resource developed by R Nave at Georgia State University, providing interconnected explanations of physics concepts from classical mechanics to modern physics. The site uses hierarchical concept maps to help students and educators navigate fundamental laws including Coulomb's law, Gauss' law, Snell's Law, and the Lorentz transformation.

## Key Topics

- Electromagnetism and electric fields
- Coulomb's law and Gauss' law
- Optics: refraction, Snell's Law, Huygens' principle
- Special relativity and Lorentz transformation
- Nuclear physics and shell model
- Lorentz force law
- Pauli exclusion principle and fermions
- Quantum mechanics: square well, harmonic oscillator
- Point charges and electric permittivity
- Magnetic permeability and electromagnetic constants
- Kinetic theory and diffusion
- Wave optics and light bending
- Physics fundamentals and classical laws

## Electromagnetism

- [Electric field](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/electric/elefie.html): Electric field fundamentals with Coulomb's, Gauss', and Lorentz force laws
- [Electric Field, Spherical Geometry](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/electric/elesph.html): Spherical electric fields using Gauss' law and Coulomb's law

## Relativity

- [Time dilation/length contraction](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/Relativ/tdil.html): Special relativity effects via Lorentz transformation and proper time

## Optics

- [Refraction of Light](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/geoopt/refr.html): Light refraction principles covering Snell's Law and Huygens' principle

## Nuclear Physics

- [Shell Model of Nucleus](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/Nuclear/shell.html): Nuclear shell model explaining magic numbers and nucleon energy levels

## Thermodynamics and Kinetic Theory

- [Diffusion and Osmosis](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/Kinetic/diffus.html): Molecular diffusion and osmosis in kinetic theory and biology
